title: Quality Control Engineer
description:
QC Engineer –
 **Stainless Steel Manufacturing** 

 Department: Quality Control
 



 Location: Sanand
 



 Employment Type: Full\-Time
 



 Experience: 3\-5 Years
 



 Industry: Stainless Steel Manufacturing / Metal Processing
 


 Job Summary
 
 We are looking for a QC Engineer to join our stainless steel manufacturing plant. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring that raw materials, manufacturing processes, and finished products meet specified quality standards, customer requirements, and applicable industry standards.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 * Inspect and monitor the quality of raw materials, in\-process materials, and finished stainless steel products.
* Perform dimensional, visual, and surface\-quality inspections at different stages of production.
* Review and verify material specifications, drawings, inspection standards, and customer requirements.
* Conduct and monitor tests such as:
* Chemical composition / PMI
* Hardness testing
* Tensile and other mechanical tests
* Surface finish and dimensional inspection
* Corrosion\-related tests, where applicable
* Coordinate with production and other departments to identify and resolve quality issues.
* Prepare and maintain inspection reports, test reports, rejection reports, and quality records.
* Handle non\-conformities and support root\-cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions (CAPA).
* Monitor process parameters and ensure compliance with approved quality procedures.
* Ensure proper identification, traceability, and documentation of materials and finished products.
* Assist in internal, customer, and third\-party quality inspections/audits.
* Ensure compliance with relevant standards such as ASTM, ASME, EN, ISO, and customer\-specific specifications, as applicable.
* Support calibration and maintenance of inspection and testing equipment.
* Prepare Material Test Certificates (MTC), inspection reports, and other quality documentation when required.
* Maintain a strong focus on reducing rejection, rework, and customer complaints.


 Required Qualifications
 * Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical, Metallurgy, Production, or related engineering discipline.
* 2–5 years of experience in Quality Control, preferably in stainless steel, steel, metal processing, fabrication, or related manufacturing industries.
* Good knowledge of stainless steel grades such as SS 304, 316, 321, 310, 410, 430, etc.
* Knowledge of inspection instruments such as Vernier caliper, micrometer, height gauge, gauges, surface roughness tester, etc.
* Understanding of material testing and quality inspection procedures.
* Knowledge of 7 QC tools, RCA, CAPA, 5 Why, and basic problem\-solving techniques.
* Ability to read engineering drawings and understand dimensional tolerances.
* Good knowledge of MS Office and quality documentation.


 Preferred Skills
 * Experience with PMI / OES / spectrometer testing.
* Knowledge of NDT methods such as UT, DPT, MPT, or relevant certifications.
* Familiarity with ISO 9001 QMS.
* Experience in handling customer and third\-party inspections.
* Knowledge of stainless steel manufacturing processes such as rolling, annealing, pickling, cutting, slitting, polishing, and finishing, depending on plant operations.
* Strong analytical, communication, and problem\-solving skills.


 Key Performance Areas
 * Product quality and specification compliance
* Reduction of rejection and rework
* Timely inspection and release of materials
* Accurate quality documentation
* Effective handling of non\-conformities
* Customer complaint reduction
* Compliance with quality standards and procedures

title: Senior Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
**About Dash Technologies**
 Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Dublin, Ohio, USA, Dash Technologies Inc. is a healthcare\-focused technology company with a global delivery center in Ahmedabad, India. For more than 15 years, Dash has partnered with healthcare and MedTech organizations to design and engineer digital health solutions spanning Medical IoT, device and system integration, connected applications, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data analytics. Dash combines strong engineering capabilities with practical execution to advance healthcare’s digital transformation and improve care delivery.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 Dash Technologies is seeking an experienced
 **Manual Software Tester / QA Engineer** 
 to support software testing and quality assurance for a Medical Device Software product being built from scratch.
   

  

 You will be responsible for developing and executing test cases, identifying and tracking defects, supporting verification and validation activities, and ensuring high\-quality software releases.
   

  

 This is a
 **hands\-on individual contributor role** 
 focused primarily on manual testing. Experience with test automation is desirable but
 **optional** 
 .
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

 Manual Software Testing
   

  

* Develop, review, and maintain test cases, test scenarios, test scripts, and test data.
* Execute functional, regression, integration, system, exploratory, and user acceptance testing.
* Analyze requirements and create comprehensive test scenarios covering positive, negative, boundary, and edge cases.
* Identify, document, and track software defects through resolution using bug\-tracking tools.
* Perform retesting and regression testing after defect fixes and software changes.
* Review test results and provide clear testing status and release\-readiness updates.
* Validate software functionality across different environments, configurations, and supported platforms.
* Participate in release testing and ensure identified issues are appropriately addressed before release.


 Requirements and Test Coverage
   

  

* Review business, functional, and technical requirements to ensure they are testable and clearly understood.
* Identify gaps, ambiguities, dependencies, and potential risks in requirements.
* Define acceptance criteria and contribute to backlog refinement.
* Maintain traceability between requirements, test cases, defects, and test results where required.
* Collaborate with product and engineering teams to clarify expected behavior and acceptance criteria.


 Quality Assurance
   

  

* Contribute to test planning and overall QA strategy for the product.
* Maintain organized and accurate testing documentation and records.
* Ensure testing activities are performed consistently across development cycles.
* Participate in defect triage, root cause discussions, and quality reviews.
* Communicate testing progress, risks, blockers, and quality concerns to relevant stakeholders.
* Support continuous improvement of testing processes and practices.


 Agile Testing
   

  

* Work closely with Agile development teams throughout the sprint lifecycle.
* Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Perform testing within development sprints rather than only at the end of the development cycle.
* Collaborate with developers to reproduce, investigate, and resolve defects.
* Ensure acceptance criteria are adequately covered before stories are considered complete.
* Support appropriate quality gates before software releases.


 Test Automation — Optional
   

  

* Experience with test automation is an advantage but is not mandatory.
* Contribute to identifying suitable test cases for automation.
* Work with automation engineers or developers to improve automated test coverage.
* Basic experience with automation tools or frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar is desirable.
* Familiarity with CI/CD\-based automated testing is a plus.


 Cross\-Functional Collaboration
   

  

* Partner with product managers and business analysts to understand requirements and expected outcomes.
* Work closely with software developers to investigate and resolve defects.
* Collaborate with other QA team members to improve test coverage and testing practices.
* Communicate testing status, defects, risks, and blockers clearly to project stakeholders.
* Participate in product demonstrations and reviews to understand new functionality.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Electronics, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* At least 3–5 years of experience in software testing or quality assurance.
* Strong hands\-on experience in manual software testing.
* Experience developing and executing test cases, test scenarios, test scripts, and test plans.
* Experience performing functional, regression, integration, system, and exploratory testing.
* Strong understanding of software testing concepts and Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Experience identifying, documenting, and tracking defects using tools such as Jira or similar platforms.
* Experience working with Agile methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently.
* Experience with test management tools such as Jira, TestRail, Zephyr, QATouch, or similar platforms.


 Bonus Points
   

  

* Experience testing Medical Device Software, Healthcare Software, or MedTech products.
* Experience working on products developed from scratch.
* Experience testing web applications, mobile applications, APIs, or integrated systems.
* Basic knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman or similar.
* Basic SQL/database testing experience.
* Experience with test automation tools such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Appium, or similar.
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and automated test execution.
* Experience with performance, usability, compatibility, or security testing.
* Experience working in a startup or new product development environment.
* Experience with Medical IoT or connected healthcare applications.


 How You Work
   

  

 Skills and Competencies
   

  

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Ability to think from an end\-user perspective and identify unexpected scenarios.
* Strong defect investigation and root cause analysis skills.
* Good understanding of risk\-based testing and test prioritization.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple testing activities.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work effectively with developers, product managers, business analysts, and other stakeholders.
* Strong ownership of assigned testing activities.
* Willingness to learn new technologies, tools, and testing techniques.

* Quality Mindset: Commitment to delivering reliable, high\-quality software.
* Customer Focus: Ability to understand software from the user's perspective.
* Attention to Detail: Thoroughness in identifying defects and validating functionality.
* Collaboration: Effective communication and teamwork across technical and non\-technical teams.
* Continuous Improvement: Interest in improving testing processes, coverage, and efficiency.


 Why Join Dash

* A hands\-on QA role supporting a Medical Device Software product from the ground up.

title: Specialist - Pilot line Coating Calendaring
description:
Purpose of the Role
   

  

 Own the technical process for Electrode operations Feeding/Mixing, Slot Die coating, and Calendaring on the Pilot Line. Develop, validate, and standardize process parameters for each chemistry (e.g., LFP, NMC, or other emerging chemistries), and lead DOE studies to define robust process windows ahead of scale\-up to mass production. Act as the technical bridge between R\&D, Quality, and Production during chemistry changeovers and NPI trials translating formulation/design inputs into executable process specifications and control plans and troubleshooting process deviations using engineering root\-cause methods. Ensure process data is captured accurately in MES/SAP to support Cpk/SPC analysis and CAPA closure.
   

  

 Key Responsibility Areas
   

  

* Develop and own process parameters (slurry viscosity/rheology, mixing time, coating weight, coating speed, calendaring pressure/gap) for each chemistry run on the Electrode Pilot Line.
* Design and execute DOE studies to establish and validate process windows for new chemistries, materials, or equipment settings; analyze results and issue updated process specifications.
* Author and maintain Process Control Plans, PFMEA, and process specifications/SOPs for the Electrode Pilot Line, updating them for every chemistry changeover.
* Lead first\-article/first\-off process validation for new chemistry or material introductions before handing over to Production for trial builds.


 Knowledge Generic
   

  

* 5–10 years of process engineering experience in Li\-ion cell, EV battery pack, or solar cell manufacturing, with hands\-on ownership of process development, NPI, or multi\-chemistry changeover work
* Deep technical knowledge of Feeding/Mixing, Slot Die coating, and Calendaring, and how parameters shift across chemistries into process specifications
* Strong grounding in DOE, Six Sigma, and process control (PFMEA, Control Plans, Cpk/SPC); skilled across problem\-solving tools (8D, 7 QC, 5\-Why, Fishbone)
* Working knowledge of IATF 16949, SAP/ERP, and MES for process and quality data analysis
* Proven cross\-functional coordination with R\&D, Quality, and Production to convert chemistry/product requirements into a validated, repeatable process


 Job Context
   

  

* Support qualification of new electrode formulations and process parameters ahead of scale\-up; document changeover process windows, learnings, and risks for technology transfer to the Gigafactory line.
* Coordinate with R\&D to translate new chemistry/formulation requirements into achievable, repeatable Pilot Line process settings.
* Coordinate with equipment suppliers/OEMs on process\-related equipment capability, calibration, and upgrades needed to support new chemistries.
* Analyze process capability (Cpk), SPC trends, and NG/defect data captured in MES/SAP to identify process drift and drive corrective action.
* Lead technical root\-cause investigations for process\-related exceptions and NG products, using 8D, Six Sigma, 7 QC Tools, 5\-Why, Fishbone/Ishikawa, and FMEA; verify CAPA effectiveness.

We’re looking for a hands\-on Deployment Textile Engineer to support the deployment and operation of our OneWeave™ 3D weaving technology at our manufacturing partner in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, near Naroda Road.
   

  

 You’ll be the first line of textile technical support onsite, working alongside factory operators, a project manager, field service technician, and unspun’s remote textile and mechanical engineering teams. You’ll investigate what’s happening in production, run tests, analyze results, solve textile and process problems, and turn what we learn on the factory floor into continuous improvement.
   

  

 You’ll also represent unspun at our partner facility, building trusted relationships and helping teams across both organizations work effectively together.
   

  

 When applying, use the word shark in your cover letter.
   

  

**Why This Role Matters**
 OneWeave™ combines textiles, robotics, sensors, software, and industrial automation to create garments and textile products directly from yarn.
   

  

 As we deploy and ramp this technology in production, we need textile engineering expertise directly on the factory floor. When something involving weaving, yarn, materials, fabric quality, or process performance isn’t behaving as expected, you’ll help determine what’s happening, why it’s happening, and what we should do next.
   

  

 You’ll connect what’s happening onsite in Ahmedabad with the teams developing OneWeave™ in the US, helping us improve both the technology and how we operate it.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Support the deployment, testing, ramp\-up, and continuous improvement of OneWeave™ at our partner factory
* Serve as the first line of response for weaving, yarn, material, fabric quality, and textile process issues
* Develop and execute test plans, operate OneWeave™ equipment, and support daily textile testing and production runs
* Perform quality testing inspection, analyzing weaving inputs and outputs using quantitative and qualitative data to identify patterns, problems, and opportunities for improvement
* Investigate textile and process issues, determine likely causes, test potential solutions, and document results
* Assess and prioritize issues based on severity, production impact, available workarounds, and urgency
* Partner with factory operations and US\-based textile, mechanical, and development teams to troubleshoot and resolve issues
* Support yarn and material sourcing, supplier communication, testing, and validation for development and production runs
* Work with material vendors and suppliers on testing requirements, standards, and performance
* Develop and improve machine operation and testing SOPs, troubleshooting guides, training manuals, and supporting documentation
* Identify recurring problems and opportunities to improve equipment, materials, processes, documentation, and training
* Provide clear, concise updates to US\-based teams on factory status, testing, project progress, risks, findings, and next steps
* Capture technical information so engineers who aren't physically onsite can understand factory issues and take action


**Who You Are**
 You’re a textile engineer who likes being close to the actual work. You understand fibers, yarns, woven structures, fabric quality, and manufacturing processes, but you’re also comfortable getting onto the factory floor, operating equipment, running tests, and figuring out why something isn’t working as expected.
   

  

 You’re curious and methodical. You don't simply fix a symptom and move on. You gather information, test assumptions, analyze results, and try to understand the underlying cause.
   

  

 You also know that deployment work is collaborative. You can build strong working relationships with factory operators and managers while partnering effectively with engineers and teams thousands of miles away.
   

  

 When production pressure is high, you remain composed, communicate clearly, and keep moving the work toward resolution.
   

  

**What Makes You a Great Fit?**
* Hands\-on experience with production weaving, textile manufacturing, fabric development, and textile quality systems
* Strong understanding of textile fibers, yarn properties, woven structures, fabric quality, and manufacturing constraints
* Experience developing and executing textile or manufacturing test plans
* Ability to collect and analyze quantitative and qualitative data and translate findings into practical improvements
* Experience troubleshooting textile, weaving, material, quality, or production\-process issues
* Experience working directly in a factory or production environment
* Familiarity with quality systems, root\-cause analysis, production metrics such as Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) and downtime analysis, or continuous\-improvement methods
* Experience working with yarn or material suppliers on sourcing, testing, validation, or quality
* Strong written and verbal communication with factory operators, engineers, suppliers, and leadership
* Ability to document technical findings clearly for teams that aren't physically onsite
* Strong ownership, judgment, reliability, and process discipline


**Education**
 Degree or diploma in Textile Engineering, Textile Technology, or a closely related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
   

  

**Language Requirements**
* Professional working English required
* Professional working proficiency in Gujarati or Hindi required for effective factory\-floor communication (proficiency in both is strongly preferred)


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience troubleshooting automated textile manufacturing equipment
* Production deployment, ramp\-up, commissioning, or New Product Introduction (NPI) experience
* Experience designing practical experiments and translating results into production improvements
* Lean Manufacturing, Lean Six Sigma, structured root\-cause analysis, or continuous\-improvement experience
* Experience using OEE, downtime, quality, or other production data to investigate manufacturing performance
* Experience developing SOPs, troubleshooting guides, or training materials
* Experience supporting technical teams across countries and time zones


**Schedule**
 This is an onsite role based at our partner factory near Naroda Road in Ahmedabad, India.
   

  

 The factory operates across three shifts. You’ll primarily support the first and second shifts and participate in on\-call coverage.
   

  

 During onboarding, deployment, and factory ramp\-up, extended onsite days may be required. Longer\-term hours will vary based on operational needs.
   

  

 Some work outside normal local hours will be required for urgent production support and collaboration with US\-based teams.
   

  

 You must live close enough to the factory to provide practical onsite support when needed.
   

  

**International Travel**
 Travel may include approximately one two\-week visit per quarter, including travel to unspun's headquarters and micro\-factory in Emeryville, California for training, textile development, testing, and collaboration with our US teams.
   

  

**Why unspun?**
 We're not just another tech company \- we're a team revolutionizing a trillion\-dollar industry. Here's what makes us special:
   

  

* Mission\-Driven: We're united by our goal of reducing the carbon footprint of the global apparel industry through automation
* Innovation at Scale: We're backed by top climate\-tech VCs and working with major brands
* Amazing Team: Work with passionate experts who care about impact


**Our Culture**
 We're relentless in pursuing our mission, intentional in our decisions, and fundamentally human in how we work together. We celebrate small wins, speak up to benefit many, and aren't afraid to make mistakes along the way.
   

  

**Our Philosophy**
 We won't roll our eyes if your socks don't match. We get it. But then, if you spend those extra few minutes in the morning matching your socks and shirt, we get that too. Our workspaces are sometimes spotless and sometimes chaotic, and we celebrate messy exploration. We work through complex problems but generate simple and elegant solutions. We strive to look at things differently, and never do anything solely because "that's the way it's always been done."
   

  

 We're a team of designers and engineers, industry\-veterans and serial entrepreneurs, artists and developers. We're aspiring chess masters and climbers, bakers and photographers. Originally spun out of Stanford and the University of Colorado, we now call the SF Bay Area home, with strong ties to Hong Kong. We are looking for teammates who share our desire to work on ambitious problems and leave the world better than we found it.
   

  

*unspun is an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to being a diverse team that reflects a broad range of background, thought, and experience. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, national origin, status as an individual with a disability, status as protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristics. Women, minorities, and people from underrepresented backgrounds are strongly encouraged to apply.*

 The Residential Solar Execution Executive will be responsible for conducting technical site surveys, ensuring installation quality, and managing the field execution of residential rooftop solar projects across Ahmedabad. The role involves assessing customer sites, coordinating with installation teams, monitoring project progress, and ensuring successful commissioning of solar systems while maintaining high standards of quality and customer satisfaction.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Technical Site Survey \& System Design
   

  

* Conduct site surveys for residential rooftop solar projects.
* Assess roof dimensions, structure, shading analysis, and electrical infrastructure.
* Evaluate customer load requirements and determine appropriate system sizing.
* Prepare accurate Bills of Materials (BOM) and component requirements.
* Identify technical challenges and recommend suitable installation solutions.


 Project Execution \& Coordination
   

  

* Coordinate with installation teams to ensure timely project execution.
* Monitor project schedules and track installation progress.
* Ensure availability of required materials and equipment at project sites.
* Resolve on\-site technical issues and support installation teams during execution.


 Quality Assurance \& Inspection

* Verify module mounting structures, inverter installations, cabling, earthing, and safety compliance.
* Conduct quality checks at various stages of project execution.

 Commissioning \& Customer Handover
   

  

* Support final testing and commissioning of solar power systems.
* Ensure systems are functioning as per design specifications.
* Coordinate customer handover and provide basic operational guidance.
* Assist in resolving post\-installation technical concerns.


 Documentation \& Compliance
   

  

* Maintain project records, survey reports, and installation documentation.
* Assist with net\-metering technical documentation and utility submission requirements.
* Ensure compliance with company quality standards and safety guidelines.

title: Electrical Quality Engineer
description:
Job Description – Electrical Quality Engineer
 



 Position: Electrical Quality Engineer
 



 Department: Quality / Electrical
 



 Qualification: Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical Engineering
 



 Experience: 2–5 Years
 



 Location: Ahmedabad / Project Sites
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 • Inspect and verify electrical materials, equipment, and installation work as per approved drawings and specifications.
 



 • Conduct quality inspections and testing of electrical systems, panels, cables, transformers, earthing, lighting, and related equipment.
 



 • Ensure compliance with project specifications, quality standards, and applicable electrical codes.
 



 • Review drawings, BOQs, specifications, and method statements for quality requirements.
 



 • Prepare and maintain inspection reports, checklists, test reports, NCRs, and quality documentation.
 



 • Coordinate with site engineers, contractors, consultants, and clients for quality inspections and approvals.
 



 • Identify quality issues and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
 



 • Monitor workmanship and ensure proper installation practices at project sites.
 



 • Conduct material inspection and verify test certificates and quality documents.
 



 • Support internal and external quality audits.
 



 • Ensure proper documentation and maintain project quality records.
 



 •    Prepare and maintain HOTO (Handing Over \& Taking Over) documentation for completed electrical works.
 



 • Coordinate with site, project, and client teams for smooth project handover.
 



 • Verify that all electrical installations, testing, commissioning, and quality requirements are completed before handover.
 



 • Ensure submission of as\-built drawings, test reports, inspection reports, O\&M manuals, warranties, and other handover documents.
 



 • Conduct joint inspections with the client/consultant and close all pending observations and punch points.
 



 • Maintain proper records of HOTO documents and obtain necessary approvals/sign\-offs.
 



 Required Skills
 



 • Good knowledge of electrical systems, testing, and installation.
 



 • Knowledge of electrical drawings and technical specifications.
 



 • Knowledge of quality control procedures and inspection techniques.
 



 • Familiarity with IS/IEC standards and electrical safety requirements.
 



 • Good communication, coordination, and problem\-solving skills.
 



 • Proficiency in MS Office and basic documentation.
 



 • Ability to work independently and at project sites.
 



 Preferred
 



 • Experience in Electrical EPC / MEP / Industrial Projects.
 



 • Knowledge of QA/QC documentation and NCR/CAPA procedures.
 



 • Experience in handling client/consultant inspections.
